title: Two rings on black

techniques.name: Glowing dot ring

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.note: Angle of the right-hand view, held still: 0 is seen from above, 90 from the side. The page sweeps it over time.

strands.label: Strands
strands.note: How many strands the record holds, as a multiple of the page’s own.

breath.label: Breath
breath.note: How much the lightness swells along the record (the page’s breath, 7 on this figure).

dot.label: Dot size
dot.note: Size of every strand mark, as a multiple of the page’s own.

techniques.implementation: Dots on a ring are drawn with a soft halo on black; chords and waves sit under the ring as thin lines. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
